last_summary: The local-state evidence supports a preparation-to-assembly chain: v4 shows the chef handling a cloth while rice and salmon remain separate and static; v1 shows hands approaching those separate components; v3 shows the salmon slice being moved from the board toward off-screen assembly while rice is shaped; v2 shows rice being pressed onto salmon and then a finished nigiri being held. This supports the chronological order v4 -> v1 -> v3 -> v2.
